# Référence des CLI Maelys Git Core

Contrat commun : `agent-cli/v2`, implémenté par `libmaelys_cli`. Pour le
détail machine, exécutez `BINAIRE describe COMMAND_ID --format json`. Cette
page est générée par `maelys-cli-reference` depuis les binaires ; ne la
modifiez pas à la main.

La référence décrit le produit complet. La disponibilité effective de la
commande `maelys-git-agent run` dépend de l'option de compilation Cloud et
reste indiquée par `describe` dans chaque binaire.

## `maelys-git` (Maelys Git Core)

| Identifiant | Usage | Effet | Sortie | But |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| help | `help [COMMAND_ID] \| --help` | read | json-envelope | Show the generated CLI guide or one command's help. |
| version | `version \| --version` | read | json-envelope | Return product identity. |
| describe | `describe [COMMAND_ID] [--summary] [--prefix PREFIX]` | read | json-envelope | Return the machine-readable catalog, summary or one descriptor. |
| completion | `completion SHELL` | read | json-envelope | Print the shell completion script generated from the catalog. |
| complete.candidates | `__complete [WORDS...]` | read | json-records | Return completion candidates for a partial command line. |
| validate | `validate MANIFEST [--grants FILE]` | read | json-envelope | Validate a Datalog policy manifest. |
| authorize | `authorize MANIFEST PRINCIPAL REPOSITORY OPERATION [REF] [PATH...] [--explain] [--grants FILE]` | read | json-envelope | Evaluate one authorization request. |
| parse-ssh | `parse-ssh COMMAND` | read | json-envelope | Parse a forced SSH Git command. |
| repo.init | `repo init ROOT REPOSITORY [--git FILE] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or create a bare repository. |
| repo.list | `repo list ROOT [--include-stored]` | read | json-envelope | Inventory active repositories and optionally recoverable stored repositories. |
| repo.inspect | `repo inspect ROOT REPOSITORY [--git FILE]` | read | json-envelope | Inspect the identity, HEAD, refs and object storage of an active repository. |
| repo.rename | `repo rename ROOT SOURCE TARGET [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or atomically rename an active repository. |
| repo.archive | `repo archive ROOT REPOSITORY STORAGE_ID [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or move a repository into recoverable archive storage. |
| repo.delete | `repo delete ROOT REPOSITORY STORAGE_ID [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or move a repository into recoverable trash without erasing objects. |
| repo.restore | `repo restore ROOT STORAGE_ID --from archive\|trash [--as REPOSITORY] [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or restore an archived or deleted repository. |
| repo.mirror | `repo mirror SOURCE_ROOT REPOSITORY TARGET_ROOT [--as REPOSITORY] [--git FILE] [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--expected-target-identity IDENTITY\|absent] [--expected-source-fingerprint SHA256] [--expected-target-fingerprint SHA256] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or idempotently synchronize a complete local bare mirror. |
| repo.diff | `repo diff ROOT REPOSITORY OLD_OID NEW_OID [--git FILE]` | read | json-envelope | List changed paths between Git objects. |
| repo.update-ref | `repo update-ref ROOT REPOSITORY REF NEW_OID OLD_OID [--git FILE] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or compare-and-swap a Git reference. |
| keys.compile | `keys compile KEY_DIRECTORY OUTPUT SHELL ROOT MANIFEST [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or atomically compile forced-command SSH keys. |
| migrate.gitolite | `migrate gitolite INPUT OUTPUT [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Compile the safe Gitolite ACL subset and report every incompatible entry. |
| pr.check | `pr check ROOT REPOSITORY BASE_OID HEAD_OID --style ff\|merge\|squash [--git FILE] [--message TEXT] [--source-repository REPOSITORY] [--source-ref REF] [--max-source-objects COUNT] [--max-source-bytes BYTES]` | read | json-envelope | Compute merge-base, conflicts, emptiness and a prepared result in an isolated quarantine. |
| pr.merge | `pr merge ROOT REPOSITORY BASE_REF BASE_OID HEAD_OID MANIFEST PRINCIPAL --style ff\|merge\|squash --approvals COUNT --required-approvals COUNT [--git FILE] [--grants FILE] [--expected-grants-fingerprint SHA256] [--message TEXT] [--status-checks-passed] [--blocking-review] [--pr-id ID] [--source-repository REPOSITORY] [--source-ref REF] [--max-source-objects COUNT] [--max-source-bytes BYTES] [--expected-source-identity IDENTITY] [--expected-target-identity IDENTITY] [--expected-prepared-oid OID] [--expected-policy-fingerprint SHA256] [--apply]` | preview then apply with --apply | json-envelope | Plan or execute a gated, reauthorized pull request merge with reviewed repository identities and compare-and-swap. |

Options globales :

- `--format text|json|jsonl`: Select text for humans, json for one envelope or jsonl for records.
- `--json`: Exact alias of --format json.
- `--compact`: Render JSON on a single line.
- `--pretty`: --pretty=false selects compact JSON.
- `--non-interactive`: Never prompt; fail instead of asking a question.
- `--color auto|always|never`: Control ANSI colors on terminals.
- `--progress auto|always|never`: Show the progress of a long run on stderr in text mode: auto only when stderr is a terminal.
- `--verbose`: Add the details of the run on stderr in text mode; silent in JSON.
- `--pager auto|always|never`: Page the text rendering when stdout is a terminal; never in a pipe, in JSON or under --non-interactive.
- `--field NAME`: Render one top-level member of data instead of the whole result, by the text or jsonl rendering rules.
- `--help`: Show the help of the selected command.
